card.name: Words just before treatment or dose terms
card.fires_on: Words in drug-label text that sit right before a treatment, dosing or brand-name term, such as 'require', 'for', 'the' or the start of 'migraine'. Also the first pieces of a split brand name or of the word migraine.

modes.label: Migraine treatment
modes.description: Responds partway through the word migraine, or on it, in headings and sentences about acute treatment.
modes.example: 2.1 Recommended Dosing for Acute Treatment of M<<igr>>aine The recommended dose of NURTE

modes.label: Brand name pieces
modes.description: Responds on the opening pieces of a split brand name after words like duration of or in.
modes.example: The duration of<< Z>>ARXIO therapy needed to attenuate

modes.label: Linking words before care or dose terms
modes.description: Responds on small words such as for, the, or require before a treatment or dose phrase.
modes.example: Immediately withhold PADCEV and consider referral<< for>> specialized care for suspected SJS or TEN

card.writes: It seems to suppress diet and avoidance words like foods and avoid, steering away from lifestyle advice.
card.plain: It fires on small words and name pieces just ahead of a treatment or dose statement in a drug label.
